description: JPEG screenshot of the app. Use only for visual/layout questions; app_snapshot is cheaper for finding elements. With saveTo, writes the file and returns only its path (no image tokens).

area.description: auto (default) = visible screen; window = whole window incl. overlays

fullScroll.description: capture the whole content of the main scroll view as one tall image

saveTo.description: file path (.jpg) to save instead of returning the image

name: app_screenshot
